preserved_initial_capture.description: The original genuine ten-case capture before evaluator-test repair; it remains evidence and was not replaced with synthetic results.

agent.name: Codex
agent.initial_topology: three native isolated child agents, each assigned sequential historical worktrees
agent.repair_topology: two fresh native isolated child agents for only ML-LLM-001 and ML-PERF-001

results.elapsed_status: partial; two repaired reruns did not expose independently measured elapsed time

evaluator_test_repair.mechanism: Each fresh worker completed in a detached worktree at the retained parent revision. The evaluator then injected only manifest-declared missing test or fixture files from the retained fixing revision, verified SHA-256 values, and ran the case's required check.

results.ML-LLM-001: The payload was injected deterministically. The candidate passed its provider-free observable validation but the injected historical test failed at collection because it imports historical public symbols absent from the alternative candidate. Correctness remains true; required verification is false and the incompatibility is retained.
results.ML-PERF-001: The payload was injected deterministically. The candidate failed the injected test at collection because its alternative does not expose the historical state-cache contract. Independent evaluator review also found it did not re-establish content identity after a retained artifact path changes, so correctness remains false.

primary_metric_interpretation.correctness: Evaluator-established observable outcome, architecture/policy review, and concrete failure evidence determine correctness; historical implementation overlap does not.
primary_metric_interpretation.verification: Required-check success is reported independently. A historical regression that imports an implementation-specific API is not recast as a scope violation or historical-reference miss.
primary_metric_interpretation.scope: Only evaluator-recorded concrete unrelated changes count as verified_scope_violations. There were none in this run.
primary_metric_interpretation.efficiency: Historical-reference recall, tool/file reads, tokens, and cost are diagnostic or secondary. Unavailable telemetry remains unavailable.

exact_process: Validate corpus and protocol: python scripts/quality/agent_engineering_benchmark.py validate --corpus benchmarks/agent-engineering/cases.json; python scripts/quality/agent_engineering_benchmark.py validate-protocol --corpus benchmarks/agent-engineering/cases.json --injections benchmarks/agent-engineering/evaluator-injections.json
Create each comparison worktree at its predeclared starting_revision, which must equal fix_commit^.
Give workers only the protocol task_prompt; retain historical reference files, fixing diffs, evaluator checks, and injection contents with the evaluator.

After a worker stops, inject only its manifest-declared payload: python scripts/quality/agent_engineering_benchmark.py prepare-evaluator-worktree --case-id <id> --worktree <path> --injections benchmarks/agent-engineering/evaluator-injections.json
Run evaluator checks and record the command, exit code, injection provenance, candidate files, verified scope findings, primary metrics, and unavailable telemetry.

Re-score the canonical run: python scripts/quality/agent_engineering_benchmark.py score --corpus benchmarks/agent-engineering/cases.json --run-record benchmarks/agent-engineering/baselines/codex-pre-phase1-run.json --output benchmarks/agent-engineering/baselines/codex-pre-phase1-score.json
freeze_rule: Any Phase-1 comparison must use pre-phase1-protocol.json unchanged. The six holdouts are prohibited from Phase-1 design or tuning and are run only after Phase-1 implementation and adoption thresholds are frozen.
